english.text: So wailed Creusa, and in wild despair / filled all the palace with her sobs and cries, / when lo! a portent, wondrous to declare. / For while, 'twixt sorrowing parents' hands and eyes, / stood young Iulus, wildered with surprise, / up from the summit of his fair, young head / a tuft was seen of flickering flame to rise. / Gently and harmless to the touch it spread / around his tender brows, and on his temples fed.

jyutping: hak1 leoi4 saat3 haam3 zo2，jin4 hau6 hai2 kwong4 je5 ge3 zyut6 mong6 jap6 min6 / jung6 keoi5 ge3 haam3 giu3 tin4 mun5 zo2 so2 jau5 gung1 din6， / dong1 jat1 go3 jyu6 siu6，kei4 miu6 gam2 syun1 bou3， / jat1 zan6， 'twixt bei1 soeng1 ge3 fu6 mou5 ge3 sau2 tung4 ngaan5 zing1， / kei5 hai2 dou6，nin4 hing1 ge3 ji1 lou5 si1，kwong4 je5 gam2 tung4 keoi5 jat1 cai4 ging1 hei2， / jau4 keoi5 go3 baak6 sik1，nin4 hing1 ge3 tau4 ge3 saan1 deng2 / jat1 cuk1 sim2 sim2 faat3 gwong1 ge3 fo2 jim6 bei6 gin3 dou2 sing1 hei2 / heng6 heng1 ji4 mou4 hoi6 ge3 mo2 lok6 heoi3，keoi5 hai2 keoi5 nyun6 waat6 ge3 mei4 mou4 zau1 wai4，tung4 maai4 hai2 keoi5 ge3 taai3 joeng4 jyut6 soeng6 min6 wai3 sik6。
text: 克雷薩喊咗，然後喺狂野嘅絕望入面 / 用佢嘅喊叫填滿咗所有宮殿， / 當一個預兆，奇妙噉宣布， / 一陣， 'twixt 悲傷嘅父母嘅手同眼睛， / 企喺度，年輕嘅伊魯斯，狂野噉同佢一齊驚喜， / 由佢個白皙，年輕嘅頭嘅山頂 / 一束閃閃發光嘅火焰被見到升起 / 輕輕而無害嘅摸落去，佢喺佢嫩滑嘅眉毛周圍，同埋喺佢嘅太陽穴上面餵食。

author: Matthewyau1367

english.text: In the 1980s, Wok with Yan was a popular Chinese cooking show in BC. That time was before the large influx of Cantonese to BC from the Hong Kong Diaspora.

jyutping: hai2 1980 nin4 doi6， Wok with Yan hai6 bei1 si1 saang2 jat1 go3 sau6 fun1 jing4 ge3 zung1 gwok3 paang1 jam6 zit3 muk6。go2 go3 si4 hau6 hai6 hai2 jyut6 jyu5 daai6 loeng6 jau4 hoeng1 gong2 kiu4 man4 jung2 jap6 BC zi1 cin4。
text: 喺1980年代， Wok with Yan 係卑詩省一個受歡迎嘅中國烹飪節目。嗰個時候係喺粵語大量由香港僑民湧入 BC 之前。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: On the sunny morning of the 9th of March of 2022, I found myself in the Lulu Island pizzeria, as Tharsan, the Sri Lankan owner, served me a pesto cheese slice. I took a cold black diet cola from the dispensing machine. Rose the Filipina and Tharsan were preparing many orders, some for schools. A loquacious, neat-looking head-shaven delivery man in a blue jacket and black track pants was loading the pizzas into his vehicle. The big screen was showing news from Seattle, but the sound was turned off, as usual.

jyutping: hai2 2022 nin4 3 jyut6 9 hou6 ge3 cing4 long5 ge3 ziu1 zou2，ngo5 faat3 jin6 zi6 gei2 hai2 lou6 lou6 dou2 ge3 bok6 beng2 pou2，jan1 wai6 si1 lei5 laan4 kaa1 ge3 lou5 baan2 taap3 song1 sung3 zo2 go3 hoeng1 syun3 zi1 si2 pin3 bei2 ngo5，ngo5 hai2 fan1 pui3 gei1 dou6 lo2 zo2 jat1 bui1 dung3 hak1 sik1 ge3 ho2 lok6，fei1 leot6 ban1 jan4 mui4 gwai3 tung4 taap3 song1 zeon2 bei6 gan2 hou2 do1 daan1，jau5 di1 hai6 jung6 lai4 zong1 zyu6 go3 daai6 zek3 ge3 hak1 sik1 ngoi6 tou3 tung4 zing2 cai4 ge3 pei1 gin1 go3 jing4 mok6 hin2 si6 gan2 lai4 zi6 sai1 ngaa5 tou4 ge3 san1 man4，daan6 hai6 go3 sing1 zau6 hou2 ci5 ping4 si4 gam2 saan1 zo2。
text: 喺2022年3月9號嘅晴朗嘅朝早，我發現自己喺露露島嘅薄餅舖，因為斯里蘭卡嘅老闆塔桑送咗個香蒜芝士片畀我，我喺分配機度攞咗一杯凍黑色嘅可樂，菲律賓人玫瑰同塔桑準備緊好多單，有啲係用嚟裝住個大隻嘅黑色外套同整齊嘅披肩個螢幕顯示緊嚟自西雅圖嘅新聞，但係個聲就好似平時噉閂咗。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Manzoni notes that when news of the sickness reached the city “anyone might suppose that there would be a general stir of disquiet, a clamor for precautions of some kind [whatever their real value] to be taken ... But one of the few points about which all the memoirs of the time agree is that there was nothing of the kind ... Anyone who mentioned the danger of the pestilence, whether in the streets, the shops or in private houses — anyone who even mentioned the word ‘plague’ — was greeted with incredulous mockery or angry contempt.”

jyutping: maan6 zo3 nei4 zi2 ceot1，dong1 ni1 go3 beng6 ge3 siu1 sik1 cyun4 dou3 sing4 si5 go2 zan6，「jam6 ho4 jan4 dou1 ho2 nang4 wui5 jing6 wai4 wui5 jau5 jat1 zung2 pou2 pin3 ge3 bat1 on1，jau5 jan4 haam3 waa6 jiu3 coi2 ceoi2 mau5 zung2 jyu6 fong4 cou3 si1［mou4 leon6 keoi5 dei6 ge3 zan1 zing3 gaa3 zik6 hai6 dim2］⋯daan6 hai6 dong1 si4 so2 jau5 wui4 jik1 luk6 dou1 tung4 ji3 ge3 siu2 sou3 dim2 zi1 jat1 hai6，mou5 jam6 ho4 ni1 zung2 je5 ... jam6 ho4 jan4 tai4 dou3 wan1 jik6 ge3 ngai4 him2，mou4 leon6 hai6 hai2 si1 jan4 fong4 uk1 jap6 min6，ding6 hai6 hai2 soeng1 dim3 jap6 min6，dou1 hai6— bei2 jan4 jung6 maai4 di1 m4 seon3 ge3 zaau1 siu3 waak6 ze2 fan5 nou6 ge3 mit6 si6 lai4 jing4 zip3。」
text: 曼佐尼指出，當呢個病嘅消息傳到城市嗰陣，「任何人都可能會認為會有一種普遍嘅不安，有人喊話要採取某種預防措施［無論佢哋嘅真正價值係點］⋯但係當時所有回憶錄都同意嘅少數點之一係，冇任何呢種嘢 ... 任何人提到瘟疫嘅危險，無論係喺私人房屋入面，定係喺商店入面，都係— 畀人用埋啲唔信嘅嘲笑或者憤怒嘅蔑視嚟迎接。」

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: It is the 15th of February of 2015. On a more personal note, I am still able to make new friends, even that I know that I cannot keep them for long when they go away. Amongst others from the delivery gang of the pizzeria are two Russian-speaking friends, the Ukrainian Yaroslav and the Kazakh Adil. The ex-Soviet peoples are highly educated. I do miss talking to Bratislav, of Croatian ancestry, about ufology and starry philosophy. (Bratislav left the Lulu Island neighbourhood in May of 2014.) As long as people can still make friends is fine.

jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 2015 nin4 2 jyut6 15 hou6。hai2 gang3 go3 jan4 ge3 gok3 dou6 lai4 gong2，ngo5 jing4 jin4 ho2 ji5 wan2 dou2 san1 pang4 jau5，zau6 syun3 ngo5 zi1 dou3 keoi5 dei6 zau2 zo2 zi1 hau6，ngo5 m4 ho2 ji5 lau4 zyu6 keoi5 dei6 hou2 noi6。bok6 beng2 pou2 ge3 sung3 caan1 bong1 kei4 taa1 jan4 dong1 zung1，jau5 loeng5 go3 gong2 ngo4 man2 ge3 pang4 jau5，wu1 hak1 laan4 jan4 ngaa5 lo4 si1 laai1 fu1 tung4 haa1 saat3 hak1 jan4 aa3 dik6 ji5。cin4 sou1 lyun4 jan4 man4 sau6 gwo3 gou1 dang2 gaau3 juk6，ngo5 hou2 gwaa3 zyu6 tung4 haak1 lo4 dei6 aa3 hyut3 tung2 ge3 bou3 laai1 dik6 si1 laai1 fu1 gong2 fei1 dip2 hok6 tung4 sing1 hung1 zit3 hok6。（bou3 laai1 dik6 si1 laai1 fu1 hai2 2014 nin4 5 jyut6 lei4 hoi1 zo2 lou6 lou6 dou2 ge3 se5 keoi1。）zi2 jiu3 jan4 dei6 zung6 ho2 ji5 gaau1 dou3 pang4 jau5 zau6 mou5 man6 tai4。
text: 呢個係2015年2月15號。喺更個人嘅角度嚟講，我仍然可以搵到新朋友，就算我知道佢哋走咗之後，我唔可以留住佢哋好耐。薄餅舖嘅送餐幫其他人當中，有兩個講俄文嘅朋友，烏克蘭人雅羅斯拉夫同哈薩克人阿迪爾。前蘇聯人民受過高等教育，我好掛住同克羅地亞血統嘅布拉迪斯拉夫講飛碟學同星空哲學。（布拉迪斯拉夫喺2014年5月離開咗露露島嘅社區。）只要人哋仲可以交到朋友就冇問題。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: There was nothing so very remarkable in that; nor did Alice think it so very much out of the way to hear the Rabbit say to itself, "Oh dear! Oh dear! I shall be too late!" (when she thought it over afterwards, it occurred to her that she ought to have wondered at this, but at the time it all seemed quite natural;) but when the Rabbit actually took a watch out of its waistcoat-pocket, and looked at it, and then hurried on, Alice started to her feet, for it flashed across her mind that she had never before seen a rabbit with either a waistcoat-pocket, or a watch to take out of it, and, burning with curiosity, she ran across the field after it, and was just in time to see it pop down a large rabbit-hole under the hedge.

jyutping: go2 gin6 si6 mou5 mat1 gam3 zik6 dak1 lau4 ji3 ge3；oi3 lai6 si1 jik6 dou1 m4 gok3 dak1 teng1 dou3 tou3 zai2 deoi3 zi6 gei2 gong2：「o2，can1 oi3 ge3！o2，can1 oi3 ge3！ngo5 wui5 taai3 ci4 laa3！」hai6 jat1 gin6 hou2 kei4 gwaai3 ge3 si6（dong1 keoi5 nam2 jyun4 zi1 hau6，keoi5 nam2 hei2 keoi5 jing1 goi1 wui5 nam2 ne1 gin6 si6，daan6 hai6 dong1 si4 ne1 jat1 cai3 ci5 fu4 dou1 gei2 zi6 jin4；）daan6 hai6 dong1 tou3 zai2 zan1 hai6 mong6 zyu6 keoi5 ge3 jiu1，jin4 hau6 haam3 zo2 ceot1 lai4 goek3，jan1 wai6 keoi5 nou5 hoi2 zung1 sim2 gwo3，keoi5 cung4 loi4 dou1 mei6 gin3 gwo3 jat1 zek3 tou3 zai2，mou4 leon6 hai6 jau5 go3 bui3 sam1 doi2，ding6 hai6 zek3 biu1 jiu3 ling1 ceot1 lai4，keoi5 hou2 kei4 ge3 sam1 jin4 siu1 hei2 soeng5 lai4，gan1 zyu6 keoi5 paau2 gwo3 tin4 je5，ngaam1 ngaam1 gin3 dou3 keoi5 hai2 syu6 zit3 haa6 min6 ge3 jat1 go3 daai6 tou3 gam2 ge3 lung1 dou6 daan6 zo2 ceot1 lai4。
text: 嗰件事冇乜咁值得留意嘅；愛麗絲亦都唔覺得聽到兔仔對自己講：「哦，親愛嘅！哦，親愛嘅！我會太遲喇！」係一件好奇怪嘅事（當佢諗完之後，佢諗起佢應該會諗呢件事，但係當時呢一切似乎都幾自然；）但係當兔仔真係望住佢嘅腰，然後喊咗出嚟腳，因為佢腦海中閃過，佢從來都未見過一隻兔仔，無論係有個背心袋，定係隻錶要拎出嚟，佢好奇嘅心燃燒起上嚟，跟住佢跑過田野，啱啱見到佢喺樹節下面嘅一個大兔噉嘅窿度彈咗出嚟。
